description: Java class 'HonoSender' that acts as a wrapper around the 'HonoClient' for integrating with JMeter. It manages AMQP connections, sends messages asynchronously, and provides start and close lifecycle methods.

classes.name: HonoSender
classes.description: A wrapper client that manages AMQP connections and message sending with lifecycle controls, integrating with JMeter testing tools.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the sender, establishing AMQP network connection.

methods.name: connectToAmqpMessagingNetwork
methods.description: Connects to the AMQP messaging network using downstream sender factory.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a downstream sender based on endpoint type and tenant.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends multiple messages in a batch to Hono and updates the sample result accordingly.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a single message to Hono, handling acknowledgment and timing, with optional wait for delivery.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes connections and cleans up resources.
